extracted.intended_audience: educators and grant writers conducting proposal-writing workshops and preparing vocational/curriculum grant proposals
extracted.subtask_description: Practical workshop-style guidance and checklists for developing and evaluating project proposal components (goals, objectives, evaluation, activities) and for preparing vocational-education curriculum grant applications in light of federal guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seven-step workshop/product development process
rubrics_metrics.description: A repeated seven-step sequence for each proposal component: (1) presentation describing/explaining/demonstrating the component; (2) participant drafts the component using provided procedures/criteria; (3) participant self-evaluates using a specially designed checklist (YES/NO plus evidence); (4) participant revises draft; (5) participant presents revision to state monitor for objective third-party evaluation using same checklist; (6) participant reworks component in light of monitor suggestions; (7) participant resubmits end product for approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the checklist at steps 3 and 5; require YES/NO answers with supporting evidence. Repeat steps for goals, objectives, evaluation, and activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the project goal consistent with the goals and priorities of the Division of Continuing Education?
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess whether the stated project goal aligns with the Division's goals and priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the project goal address problems described in the proposal's statement of needs?
rubrics_metrics.description: Check that the goal directly responds to the problems identified in the needs statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the project treat each of its distinct points of focus separately?
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the goal does not combine unrelated focuses; distinct points should be addressed separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the goal avoid rationale, explanations and background information?
rubrics_metrics.description: Goals should be succinct statements of intent, not background or justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the goal avoid specifics that should be described in objectives and activities?
rubrics_metrics.description: Goals should be general; details belong in objectives/activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the project goal describe the population to be ultimately affected?
rubrics_metrics.description: The goal should identify the target population the project intends to affect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is this population one that can be legitimately served with the special project funds?
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate whether the target population is eligible/appropriate for the funding source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the project goal describe the general behavior to be affected in this population?
rubrics_metrics.description: Goals should state, in general terms, the behavior/outcome the project aims to change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the project goal describe the general means to be used to affect this behavior?
rubrics_metrics.description: The goal may indicate the general approach (e.g., research, development) to influence behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the description of means make clear which processes will be used (research, needs assessment, development, adaptation, field-testing, dissemination)?
rubrics_metrics.description: Where means are stated, they should specify which of the listed processes will be employed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer YES/NO and provide evidence; list the processes to be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does each goal have appropriate corresponding objectives?
rubrics_metrics.description: Verify that for every goal there are objectives that relate directly to achieving it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do objectives lead toward the attainment of the goal?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives should be logically connected steps that move the project toward the stated goal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do objectives describe major outcomes?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives should focus on significant outcomes rather than trivial tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does each objective deal with only one major outcome?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives should be singular in focus to enable clear measurement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have objectives, rather than procedural details, been specified?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives should state intended outcomes, not step-by-step procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do the objectives describe specific standards for the outcomes?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives should include criteria/standards that define acceptable achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do the objectives specify deadlines for each outcome?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives should include timeframes or deadlines for achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do objectives that lead to behavioral change describe who will be affected, what behavior will be affected and to what degree?
rubrics_metrics.description: Behavioral-change objectives must specify target group, behavior, and magnitude/degree of change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are the objectives arranged in some appropriate order?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives should be sequenced logically to reflect dependencies or priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do the objectives provide an adequate basis for the selection of appropriate activities and evaluation measures?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives should be clear and specific enough to guide activity selection and evaluation design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does each objective have appropriate corresponding evaluation items?
rubrics_metrics.description: There should be evaluation items explicitly mapped to each objective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do evaluation items seem likely to measure the attainment of the corresponding objective?
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation measures should validly capture whether objectives are achieved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do the evaluation procedures for each item describe what data is to be collected and how?
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation plans must specify the data to be collected and collection methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the evaluation for each objective specify criteria?
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the criteria/standards that determine success for each objective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are the performance levels or criteria realistic and appropriate?
rubrics_metrics.description: Performance standards should be achievable and suitable given the context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the data to be collected adequate to determine if the objective has been achieved?
rubrics_metrics.description: Check whether the planned data are sufficient for judgment of attainment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the evaluation for each objective describe how data will be analyzed?
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation plans must state the methods of data analysis to be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are experimental/control/pretest/posttest design components present when appropriate?
rubrics_metrics.description: Include appropriate design elements (experimental group, control group, pretest, posttest) when relevant to validity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate which components are present; answer YES/NO and provide evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the plan of data analysis appear valid?
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess whether the proposed analysis is methodologically sound for the evaluation questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is provision made for formative evaluations to guide project management decisions?
rubrics_metrics.description: Include formative evaluation mechanisms to inform ongoing management and improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does each objective have appropriate corresponding activities?
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities must be linked directly to objectives they are intended to achieve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do activities, as listed, seem likely to lead to the attainment of the corresponding objective?
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess the plausibility that listed activities will produce the objective's outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are activities dated and in chronological order?
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities should include dates and be ordered chronologically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are activities visually depicted in a way that makes them easy to follow (timeline/flowchart)?
rubrics_metrics.description: Visual representations (timelines, flowcharts) aid clarity of activity sequencing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer YES/NO and provide evidence; provide or request timeline/flowchart.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do the timeframes for activities seem to be realistic?
rubrics_metrics.description: Time allocations for activities should be feasible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do activities indicate who will be responsible for completion?
rubrics_metrics.description: Each activity should specify responsible person(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Do the persons assigned responsibility for carrying out activities appear to have the necessary expertise?
rubrics_metrics.description: Assigned staff should have qualifications/experience appropriate to tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are all unnecessary, duplicative, overly expensive, too time-consuming, wasteful, or otherwise undesirable activities eliminated?
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities should be streamlined to avoid redundancy and inefficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do activities provide for data collection and analysis?
rubrics_metrics.description: Activity plans must include mechanisms to collect and analyze required data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do activities include preparing required reports (quarterly progress, final report, final claim)?
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure reporting requirements are included in activity plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Need and problems (Federal Register criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The application should clearly delineate the need for the project within the specified consortium of States and should indicate responsiveness to problems rather than symptoms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This criterion is weighted (score up to indicated maximum). Sections of the application must address this criterion; supporting documentation and analysis are expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objectives (Federal Register criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The objectives should be clearly stated, capable of being attained by the proposed procedures, and capable of being measured.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objectives should be measurable and realistically attainable by the methods proposed; scoring is applied per federal guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan / Management Plan (Federal Register criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The management plan should show functions to be performed and services to be provided, and the procedures for accomplishing each should be delineated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail management functions, services, and clear procedural steps; reviewers score completeness and feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Results (Federal Register criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed outcomes should be identified and described in terms of potential impact at national, State and local levels, Part I program purposes, and cost effectiveness and efficiency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe expected outcomes, their levels of impact, and analyze cost-effectiveness/efficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional capability (Federal Register criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Application should clearly set forth current curriculum strengths and the capability of the applicant to immediately initiate and maintain liaison functions with consortium States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document institutional strengths, liaison capacity, and past performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel (Federal Register criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The qualifications and experience of key staff should be appropriate for the requirements of the project; specific responsibilities should be identified for each of the key staff; at least one key staff person should devote a minimum of 50 percent of his/her time to the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List qualifications, assign responsibilities, and document percent time commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget / Estimated cost reasonableness (Federal Register criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The estimated cost should be reasonable in relation to anticipated results and the geographic area, scope, and duration of the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a detailed cost estimate and justify reasonableness relative to expected outcomes and project scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the application clearly define the need for the project?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicitly define the need in the application narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with evidence; part of the VOCATIONAL EDUCATION CURRICULUM CRITERIA (Score component).

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the application clearly define the need for the project within the specified consortium of states?
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify how the need manifests across the consortium region.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with evidence; supports appraisal of regional relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the application indicate responsiveness to problems rather than symptoms?
rubrics_metrics.description: Show that proposed actions address root problems, not just surface symptoms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has a systematic method of ferreting out key symptoms been identified?
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe systematic methods used to discover and prioritize symptoms/issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with documentation of methods (surveys, analyses, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Has a logical analysis been applied to the information on symptoms?
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply logical/analytic procedures to symptom data to derive problem statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with evidence of analytic approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has documentation been provided that clearly explains how problems were identified?
rubrics_metrics.description: Include documentation (data, reports) showing problem identification process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have problems been translated into recognized needs?
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate translation from observed problems to formally recognized needs amenable to intervention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with evidence of translation process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have institutional needs been recognized?
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify needs at the institutional (school/agency) level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have administrative needs been recognized?
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify administrative/management needs relevant to the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have teacher needs been recognized?
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify professional development or resource needs of teachers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have student/parent needs been recognized?
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify needs of students and parents affected by the curriculum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have concerned community group needs been recognized?
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify needs expressed by community stakeholders or groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has an adequate response been made to the needs?
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed project actions should adequately respond to identified needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have the needs been responded to realistically?
rubrics_metrics.description: Responses should be feasible and grounded in context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have the needs been responded to meaningfully?
rubrics_metrics.description: Responses should be substantial and likely to produce impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have the needs been responded to all the way down the line (institutional, administrative, teacher, student/parents, concerned community groups)?
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure responses address all relevant stakeholder levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have the objectives been stated clearly?
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarity of objectives is essential for evaluation and implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with evidence; part of scoring (20 points).

rubrics_metrics.name: Are the objectives capable of being attained?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives should be realistically achievable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are the objectives capable of being attained by the proposed procedures?
rubrics_metrics.description: Match objectives with methods to ensure attainability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with evidence linking methods to objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are the objectives capable of being measured?
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives must be stated so they can be measured.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are the objectives capable of being measured by the proposed evaluation design?
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure evaluation design adequately measures stated objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with evidence of evaluation-method fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the management plan show the functions to be performed?
rubrics_metrics.description: List management functions required by the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the management plan show the services to be provided?
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe services the project will deliver.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the management plan delineate the procedures for accomplishing each function to be performed?
rubrics_metrics.description: For each management function, give the procedures to accomplish it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the management plan delineate the procedures for accomplishing each service to be provided?
rubrics_metrics.description: For each service, describe the steps and procedures for delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the proposal identify proposed outcomes (results)?
rubrics_metrics.description: List the specific outcomes the project intends to produce.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with outcome descriptions tied to program purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the proposal describe proposed outcomes in terms of potential impact at national, state, and local levels?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain how outcomes will affect stakeholders at different levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with evidence and projected impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the proposal describe proposed outcomes in terms of Part I program purposes?
rubrics_metrics.description: Tie outcomes to the statutory or programmatic purposes of Part I.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the proposal identify outcomes in terms of cost effectiveness and efficiency?
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess expected cost-effectiveness and operational efficiency of proposed outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the application clearly set forth current curriculum strengths of the applicant?
rubrics_metrics.description: Document existing curriculum strengths that support project work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with evidence of strengths (programs, materials, expertise).

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the application clearly set forth the capability of the applicant immediately to initiate and maintain liaison functions with consortium states?
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate capacity to perform liaison activities promptly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with plans, staff, or prior examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the application clearly set forth the past track record of the applicant in maintaining liaison functions with consortium states?
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide history/evidence of past liaison work and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are the qualifications of key staff appropriate to the requirements of the project?
rubrics_metrics.description: Key personnel qualifications should match project needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are the experience backgrounds of key staff appropriate to the requirements of the project?
rubrics_metrics.description: Staff experience should demonstrate relevant prior work and expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have specific responsibilities been identified for each of the key staff?
rubrics_metrics.description: Assign clear roles and responsibilities to key staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with role descriptions and percent time allocations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does at least one key staff person devote a minimum of 50% of his/her time to the project?
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure sufficient staff dedication: at least one key person half-time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has an estimated cost been provided for the project?
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a project budget with estimated costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YES/NO with a detailed budget submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the estimated cost reasonable?
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess overall reasonableness of the budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the estimated cost reasonable in relation to anticipated results?
rubrics_metrics.description: Link costs to expected outcomes to judge value for money.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the estimated cost reasonable in relation to the geographical area?
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider regional cost variations when judging budget reasonableness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the estimated cost reasonable in relation to the scope of the project?
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate whether budget matches project scale and activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the estimated cost reasonable in relation to the duration of the project?
rubrics_metrics.description: Check cost proportionality relative to project timeframe.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revision exercise guidance: remove complicated questions, ambiguous words, unnecessary repetitions, non-essential words
rubrics_metrics.description: When drafting/revising criteria or questionnaires, simplify language: eliminate complicated questions, ambiguous terms, repetitions, and non-essential words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revise drafts, compare to sample acceptable revision, and refine further; used in workshop editing exercises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Questionnaire development from federal guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop curriculum criteria and then convert them into a questionnaire usable by curriculum developers to evaluate proposed curricula, based on reproduced Federal Register guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Draft rough criteria, simplify to clear questions (avoid ambiguity), revise against sample 'VOCATIONAL EDUCATION CURRICULUM CRITERIA' and finalize for local use.
